business_scope.primary_industry_name: Digital Advertising Media Arbitrage and Affiliate Lead Gen

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (offshore International Company regime administered by the Samoa International Finance Authority, SIFA)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (unitary national system, English common law heritage as modified by Samoan statutes and custom law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus, in force 13 December 2020)
Agreement between the Government of the Independent State of Samoa and the Government of the People's Republic of China on the Promotion and Protection of Investments (Samoa–China BIT)
World Trade Organization Membership (in force 10 May 2012)

Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) in force with Australia, New Zealand, the United States and the Nordic Group; no comprehensive double taxation agreement currently applies to Samoan International Companies

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987, as amended; Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007, as amended; Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2006, as amended; International Companies Rules; SIFA AML/CFT Guidelines for Commercial, Corporate and Trust Service Providers (CCTSP) and Registered Agents; beneficial ownership records are maintained at the registered agent's office in Samoa and filed with the confidential Government-held registry accessible to SIFA, the Financial Intelligence Unit and Samoan law enforcement authorities.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport or national identity card of each subscriber, director, officer and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport or identity authority of the document's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Samoa acceded, effective 25 May 2021) OR consular legalization through the Samoan embassy or consulate with jurisdiction over the issuing country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, certificate of incumbency and register of directors and members of each corporate UBO in the ownership chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or registered agent of the corporate UBO's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR consular legalization pursuant to the country-of-origin rule; bilingual certified translation required where the source document is not in English

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds / source-of-wealth statement for each UBO funding the International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized signature and seal, then Hague Apostille OR consular legalization where the bank letter originates outside Samoa

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of physical residential address of each UBO (utility bill, tenancy agreement or governmental correspondence dated within 6 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, landlord or public authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille OR consular legalization where required by the document's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified legal entity ownership chart evidencing the ultimate beneficial ownership chain, signed by the UBO and the proposed registered agent's compliance officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: UBO and licensed Samoa registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Internal compliance certification under SIFA AML/CFT Guidelines; foreign attachments to the chart are Apostilled or consularized as applicable

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors and authorized signatories against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists and Samoa's domestic sanctions designations, conducted before name reservation and repeated immediately before incorporation; mandatory politically exposed person (PEP) determination including domestic PEPs, foreign PEPs and family or close-associate status, with enhanced due diligence and ongoing transaction monitoring for any PEP; the registered agent must evidence screening output and risk-rating (Standard or Enhanced) in the AML/CFT file under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 and SIFA CCTSP guidelines; the target industry (affiliate media buying / performance advertising) is rated Medium_Risk_Enhanced, requiring enhanced source-of-funds verification, production of advertising-network or affiliate-agreement contracts, and continuous monitoring of remitter and payee transparency on ACH and wire rails.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SIFA International Companies Registry (administered by the Samoa International Finance Authority, Apia; name applications and reservations are submitted exclusively through SIFA-licensed registered agents on the SIFA e-services platform; no public direct-access portal exists).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory corporate name must be in English/Roman script and must end with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated' or the accepted abbreviations 'Ltd', 'Corp' or 'Inc'; a Chinese or other-language parallel trade name may be registered as a secondary transliterated name provided the Roman-script statutory name governs for all official purposes; the name must not be identical or deceptively similar to any existing registered name, must not imply a regulated financial activity, and must not misrepresent the entity's exempt offshore status.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservations are valid for 30 days and are non-extendable; if the proposed name is rejected, SIFA issues a written refusal stating the statutory grounds; the applicant, acting through its licensed registered agent, may (i) immediately file a revised reservation with distinguishing identifiers, or (ii) deliver a written request for reconsideration within 14 calendar days accompanied by the consent letter of the conflicting name-holder where applicable; if reconsideration fails, an administrative appeal may be filed with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 30 days of the refusal, and subsequent judicial review lies to the Supreme Court of Samoa; any approved name not taken up by incorporation before expiry is automatically released back into the registry pool.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only in the form of a SIFA-licensed registered agent's physical office in Samoa designated as the statutory registered office; a freestanding virtual mailbox or non-licensed remote address does not satisfy the registered-office obligations of the International Companies Act 1987; no Samoan business premises, employees or physical infrastructure are required for the digital advertising and affiliate lead generation activity, but centralized management and control must not be exercised from Samoa in order to preserve the non-resident tax-exempt character of the International Company.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; estimated below 5% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection, given that the entity holds no financial-services license, undertakes non-regulated advertising and affiliate services, and operates purely offshore; SIFA and the Financial Intelligence Unit predominantly rely on desk-based reviews, annual compliance returns and registered-agent inspections; unannounced premises visits are concentrated on licensed banks, trustees and high-risk corporate service providers.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and statutory name reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the SIFA Fees Regulations (offshore services fee schedule)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation registration fee (standard authorized capital up to USD 1,000,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies Act 1987 fee schedule; scaled upward for authorized capital above USD 1,000,000

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year International Company annual license fee (government annual charge)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory annual license tariff payable pro-rata on incorporation and annually thereafter on each 31 December

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Appointment of SIFA-licensed registered agent and company secretary, initial set-up and first-year retainer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard International Company with two natural-person UBOs; excludes any UBO-related filing surcharges

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Provision of statutory registered office address in Apia, Samoa (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; typically bundled with the registered agent retainer in quoted package fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT initial client due diligence file, UBO register compilation and source-of-funds review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per FATF-aligned CDD requirements and SIFA CCTSP guidelines for a Medium_Risk_Enhanced profile

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening (UN, OFAC, EU, UK and Samoa domestic lists) per UBO and director
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Commercial per-head screening rate at prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, certification and apostille or consular legalization of identity and corporate document bundles (estimated 4 bundles)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public / competent apostille authority (excludes foreign government fees, billed at cost)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for notary certification plus Apostille issuance; Samoan consular fees apply for non-Hague jurisdictions

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: External legal opinion and pre-incorporation structural review of the affiliate media-buying business scope under Samoan offshore law
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External counsel (Samoa-barred or licensed foreign adviser instructed by the registered agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed-fee market quotation for IT-scope diligence, ISIC 7310 activity classification, payment-rails review and tax-exempt status confirmation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2011; incorporation under Part II, registered office and registered agent under Part III, directors and officers under Part IV, tax exemption and fee schedules under Part IX
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation of an International Company, together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed; share capital may be zero or any agreed amount in any currency, and no statutory escrow account or deposit of paid-up capital is required for a Samoa International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: This First Board Resolution of [Company Name], a Samoa International Company, is hereby adopted on [date]. RESOLVED: That the allotment and subscription of shares set out in the Memorandum and Articles of Association are ratified and accepted. RESOLVED FURTHER: That the registered office be fixed at the office of [Registered Agent], Apia, Samoa, and that [Registered Agent] be appointed registered agent under the International Companies Act 1987. RESOLVED FURTHER: That [Director A] and [Director B] be appointed first directors, and [Officer C] be appointed corporate secretary. RESOLVED FURTHER: That any one director or the corporate secretary be authorized, jointly or singly, to execute filings, open bank accounts, and instruct counsel.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Pre-Incorporation Compliance Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IC-3 Name Reservation to the Registrar specifying up to three proposed names ending in Limited, Corporation, or Inc. The Registrar conducts a search against existing international companies, protected names, and names reserved by other legislation. Payment is made by bank draft or at the MCIL cashier. The reserved name is held for thirty days pending full incorporation.
required_dossiers: Completed Form IC-3 Name Reservation
Copy of passport of each subscriber or corporate extract for corporate subscriber
Letter of engagement from the licensed Samoa registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is refused or queried, the applicant may file a modified name with the Registrar within 14 days; the Registrar may consent to a phonetically or visually distinct alternative, or an appeal can be lodged through the MCIL internal review process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Samoa registered agent approved by the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), with notarization by a Samoan notary public or commissioner for oaths
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, stating the authorized share capital, subscriber details, and objects permitted under the International Companies Act 1987. Each subscriber must execute the instrument physically; signatures must be witnessed and notarized. If a corporate body is a subscriber, deliver a board resolution approving subscription and incumbency evidence. The document is then forwarded to the registered agent for pre-screen before filing.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Valid identification and proof of residential or registered address of each subscriber
Consent to act from each proposed director and officer
For corporate subscriber: board resolution, certificate of incumbency, and certificate of good standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent or Registrar queries identity or source-of-funds documentation, submit renewed notarized passport copies and a professional reference letter from a licensed bank or attorney; the previously executed document may be re-executed after any required correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, director and officer consents, registered agent consent, and address of the registered office in Samoa. Pay the official incorporation filing fee to the MCIL cashier or through the licensed registered agent. No minimum paid-up capital declaration is required. The Registrar examines compliance with the International Companies Act 1987 and issues the certificate upon approval.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Name reservation certificate
Consent to act as registered agent from the licensed agent
Consent to act from each director, secretary, and officer
Proof of payment of the state filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition notice, the registered agent may file a supplementary memorial or amend the constituent document within 10 working days; if the Registrar remains unsatisfied, the applicant may make a fresh application with corrected documents or pursue judicial review before the Samoa Supreme Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Statutory Post-Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues a Certificate of Incorporation under seal, recording the Samoa International Company number and date of incorporation. The registered agent retains the certified copies, prepares the share certificates, and maintains the statutory registers. The company should obtain a certified true copy of the certificate from the Registrar if needed for bank or merchant onboarding.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar
Certified copy of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered agent acknowledgement and share register opening entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains a clerical error, the company may apply for rectification through MCIL; if issued in the wrong name, a formal request supported by the name reservation certificate is filed and, if necessary, a special resolution of the subscriber approving correction is submitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Initial Governance, Share Issuance, and Registered Agent Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of directors and the licensed registered agent under the Samoa International Finance Authority framework
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or execute a written unanimous board resolution confirming the share subscription, registered office, registered agent, and officer appointments already set out in the incorporation documents. Issue original share certificates and complete the register of members, register of directors, and register of charges. Obtain the company kit containing a common seal, share certificates, and duplicate registers from the registered agent.
required_dossiers: First board resolution or written unanimous consent
Share certificates issued to the subscriber
Register of members and register of directors
Registered agent acknowledgement of office and agent appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a statutory register or board minute is incomplete, the directors may pass a ratifying resolution and record the correction; if a director or officer resigns or is replaced, file Form IC-2 Notice of Change with the Registrar and update the register accordingly.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - no physical or industrial establishment is being registered in Samoa; if the company later opens a premises, the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) and Samoa Tourism Authority may apply depending on the exact domestic operation
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating permit or industrial license is required for ISIC 7310 digital advertising, media arbitrage, and affiliate lead generation; the Samoa International Company is not engaged in insurance, banking, trust, or other restricted licensed activities

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - the offshore service company has no construction, manufacturing, or discharge undertaking, and no environmental impact assessment threshold is triggered
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or hazardous waste discharge standards apply to the digital media buying activity; if physical office infrastructure or emergency generator is later introduced, applicable standards under the Waste Management Act 2010 and Samoa Environment Act 2003 will require separate compliance

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire safety certificate, structural load inspection, or workplace clearance is legally required for a non-resident Samoa International Company with no physical Samoan premises. If the company later employs staff in Samoa or establishes an on-island office, occupational safety and health clearance under the Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013 and fire safety certification under the Fire and Emergency Services Act 2010 must be secured before operations commence.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Revenue of Samoa, Taxpayer Services Division, official portal at https://www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) is exempt from income tax under the International Companies Act 1987 and is not required to file income tax returns. To obtain an optional Tax Identification Number (TIN) for banking and cross-border commercial compliance, file Form TIN-1 with the Ministry of Revenue, attaching: (i) certificate of incorporation; (ii) registered office address certificate; (iii) copy of passport of each director/shareholder; (iv) certificate of good standing from the Registrar of International Companies. The TIN is issued within 5 business days; no tax liability attaches to the TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The IC is statutorily tax-exempt and treated as non-resident for all Samoan tax purposes. No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections are available or required.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 60,000 per annum of taxable supplies (approximately USD 21,000); however, an IC engaged exclusively in offshore media buying is outside the VAGST net as the recipient is non-resident and no local supply occurs.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API reporting, or digital stamping mandate exists in Samoa. VAGST invoices may be issued in paper or PDF format; export invoices must include the exporter's TIN, the foreign buyer's details, description of services, zero-rating notation, and invoice number.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of services (including digital advertising and affiliate lead generation) are zero-rated under the VAGST Act 2002 when: (a) the supply is made to a non-resident of Samoa; (b) the services are performed entirely outside Samoa or the benefit is enjoyed outside Samoa; and (c) the IC holds documentary evidence of the offshore nature of the transaction. The IC must obtain and retain the full evidentiary bundle for 7 years.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (form CED-EX01) — required for any physical goods; for pure services, a signed service agreement and invoice evidencing offshore supply
Bill of Lading or airway bill — required only when physical advertising collateral is shipped; otherwise a written confirmation from the media platform that the service is delivered outside Samoa
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) issued by a licensed Samoan commercial bank — required to prove foreign currency collection within the 180-day period
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims are prosecuted under the VAGST Act 2002 and the Criminal Justice Act 2016. Penalties include: (i) retrospective assessment for 5 years; (ii) a civil penalty of 200% of the tax evaded; (iii) interest at the statutory rate from the due date; (iv) clawback of any refund paid, plus monetary penalties; and (v) for natural persons, imprisonment up to 5 years. The Ministry of Revenue may also cancel the IC's TIN and impose a disqualification order on directors.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), Falefa, Apia, is the sole monetary authority and the administrator of the Exchange Control Act 1975 and the Exchange Control Regulations 1986. CBS licenses and supervises all commercial banks as foreign-exchange authorized dealers, administers the Samoa Tala (WST) managed-float exchange-rate policy, and acts as the AML/CFT supervisory authority for banks under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018 and the CBS AML/CFT Rules 2020. The Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) co-regulates the Samoa International Company under the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended through the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2021) for corporate registration, beneficial-ownership, annual-return, and economic-substance compliance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoa Tala is convertible for current-account transactions through authorized dealers without CBS pre-approval, while resident capital-account transactions require CBS consent. The WS International Company is statutorily non-resident for exchange-control purposes and is exempted from the Exchange Control Act 1975 in respect of all foreign-currency operations conducted outside Samoa. Accordingly, USD/EUR advertising-commission receivables, media-buying disbursements, intercompany funding, and profit remittances to offshore beneficial owners may be settled freely without CBS approval, without mandatory conversion into WST, and without any Samoan withholding or surrender obligation. Practical convertibility constraints arise only where the IC deliberately opens a WST-denominated account or settles local Tala vendor payables; such conversions are executed by the licensed bank at the CBS-managed interbank rate against standard source-of-funds documentation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For resident Samoan trading entities, foreign-currency export proceeds must be offered for sale to an authorized dealer within 30 days of receipt and surrendered into WST at the prevailing CBS reference rate unless a documented working-capital dispensation is granted. Because the WS_IC is a non-resident international company exempt from the Exchange Control Act, its inbound affiliate revenue streams are outside the statutory surrender regime and no mandatory conversion ratio or surrender timeline applies. Where the IC voluntarily converts foreign currency into WST, the authorized dealer records the conversion in its foreign-exchange register, but no compulsory conversion percentage is imposed on the offshore earnings.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational multi-currency account (USD/EUR/AUD/WST) with segregated treasury sub-accounts; SWIFT MT103 and Trade Finance desk
Operational USD/WST account; Capital Escrow Account for shareholder capital injection
Operational USD/WST account; Commercial Letter of Credit facility under UCP 600

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Direct onboarding of the Samoa IC to offshore digital EMIs is rated LOW. Mercury does not accept Samoa-domiciled international companies in its standard onboarding queue, Wise does not currently support Samoa as a business-account hold-and-send corridor, and Airwallex/Cross River-type platforms generally restrict Pacific offshore corporations. Legal constraints are not prohibitive because the IC's exchange-control exemption permits offshore account holding; however, reliance on an unregulated EMI as the primary treasury layer breaks the CBS-authorized-dealer chain and materially elevates correspondent and sanctions screening. The compliant architecture is to retain a CBS-licensed Samoan commercial bank as the legal funding source and, only where US ACH acceptance is required, interpose a US single-member LLC (check-the-box disregarded entity) owned by the IC, established with a US registered agent, EIN, IRS Form 5472 annual information return, transfer-pricing/intercompany funding memos, and no US market-facing activities to avoid creating a taxable US permanent establishment or effectively connected income.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The CBS AML/CFT Rules 2020 permit remote and video-based client due diligence where the authorized dealer deploys reliable e-KYC and source-of-funds verification, but in practice the licensed Samoan banks demand a physical initial interview in Apia for at least one director or the SIFA-licensed registered agent holding a duly validated power of attorney. Remaining directors and the ultimate beneficial owner may complete verification through notarized passport copies, certified proof of address, and a scheduled video call coordinated by the Samoan registered agent. For Chinese-language family-office principals, the bank accepts a certified translation bundle and a face-to-face meeting at the International Corporate Services unit; remote-only opening is rarely approved for a Medium-Risk-Enhanced media-buying profile. The registered agent can hold transactional signature authority, but the beneficial owner must remain individually identified on the relationship file.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Commerce-profile red flag: 'affiliate lead generation and media arbitrage' is treated as a high-velocity pass-through typology for payment fraud, layering, and sanctions evasion because there are no physical goods, no conventional supply-chain invoices, and revenue is commission-based.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit the SIFA certificate of incorporation and good standing, the shareholders' and board resolutions approving the media-buying mandate, executed direct-vendor contracts with named regulated platforms (Google Ireland Ltd, Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd, TikTok Pte. Ltd., principal demand-side platforms), platform manager/MCC account statements, the preceding six-month campaign performance summaries (impressions, clicks, leads, conversions), media-spend invoices from the platforms, and a board-approved AML/CFT self-risk assessment confirming zero cash usage, zero card-acquiring, zero crypto rails, and a published counterparty whitelist.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership and director-fatigue red flag: nominee directors, registered-office-only substance, and no credible wealth trail for the initial capital contribution.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lodge the complete register of directors, members, and beneficial owners in the Samoa registered-office record (mandatory under the 2021 amendments), attach notarized passports and proof of address for every director and the ultimate beneficial owner, provide a source-of-wealth and source-of-funds file (prior tax returns, audited family-office financial statements, brokerage statements, corporate sale contracts), and deliver a concise board narrative explaining the commercial rationale for the Samoan international-company treasury structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Correspondent-banking friction: the Samoa bank's USD clearing correspondent may flag outbound payments to ad-tech and affiliate payout platforms as high-risk money-service businesses, particularly unregulated affiliate networks.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Restrict treasury policy to a board-approved whitelist of regulated payees (Google, Meta, TikTok, Taboola, Outbrain, Amazon Advertising, recognized SSP/DSPs, and cloud/hosting vendors), attach platform tax-identification or VAT registration evidence, execute a written undertaking that no unlicensed payment processor will be used without prior bank notification, and provide monthly reconciliation reports mapping each outbound MT103 to a platform invoice identifier.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction-pattern mismatch: unexpectedly high velocity of outbound wires during the first 90-day seasoning period compared with the stated monthly media budget.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Present a board-approved 90-day liquidity plan and a monthly media-planning model aligned to platform billing cycles, adopt daily payment-limit controls and dual-signer authorization at the bank, procure an independent anti-fraud and media-attribution audit report covering the campaign accounts, and designate a named treasury officer available for real-time bank due-diligence calls and enhanced monitoring queries.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder funding and affiliate revenue must never arrive via commingled third-party pools. Initial capital is routed by SWIFT MT103 from the named beneficial owner's own account (matching the beneficial-ownership register) to the WS_IC's USD Capital Escrow Account at the Samoan authorized dealer, with remittance narrative 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION - INTERNATIONAL COMPANY NO. WSIC-XXXX' and the IC's full bank reference. Operating revenue is received by direct MT103 or ACH from the ad-network treasury entities (Google Ireland, Meta Platforms Ireland, TikTok treasury) into the operational USD account, each leg being matched to the master-agreement or campaign ID in the bank's CDD file and to the SIFA annual-return record. If the interposed US single-member LLC treasury sub-account is used, the IC funds it by MT103 marked 'INTERCOMPANY FUNDING / CAPITAL CALL', followed by periodic IRS Form 5472 filings and intercompany loan memos, preserving a fully traceable funding chain from Samoa to the US ACH corridor.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 from the Samoan authorized dealer in the invoice currency (USD/EUR/SGD) to the ad-network treasury counterparties, including Google Ireland Ltd (Dublin), Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd (Dublin), and TikTok Pte. Ltd (Singapore), with narrative 'TRADE DISBURSEMENT - PLATFORM INVOICE NO. XXXX' and a strict one-to-one invoice-matching protocol. Commercial letters of credit (irrevocable, confirmed by a London or US correspondent bank, subject to UCP 600) are permissible for high-value programmatic inventory bulk purchases and contracted data-supply arrangements, although they are non-standard for ordinary performance-media settlement. Within the US corridor, the interposed LLC pushes ACH credits to platform US bank accounts, backed by back-to-back MT103 funding from Samoa to preserve audit integrity. The treasury policy prohibits Western Union-style OTC corridors, crypto bridges, cash-equivalent instruments, and sweeps through unlicensed payment service providers.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright USD/WST forward contracts with a CBS-authorized dealer, tenor up to 12 months, on genuine commercial-exposure documentation.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on WST/USD executed through a licensed bank as pricing counterparty, permitted without physical Tala delivery.
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR principal exchange) arranged by the authorized dealer to hedge matched EUR media invoices.
FX options (call/put and risk-reversal structures) written by a licensed bank under the IC's exchange-control exemption, with full transaction documentation maintained in the treasury file.
Multi-currency settlement-account natural hedging and forward-dated intercompany netting as non-derivative liquidity strategies, universally permissible under the Samoan IC regime.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company License Renewal (Government Annual Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before the anniversary date of incorporation each year; invoice issued by the Registrar through the licensed registered agent.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment penalty of 10% per month or part thereof; unpaid fees for 3 consecutive months expose the IC to gazetted administrative strike-off, loss of limited liability status, and restoration costs.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry, MCIL; filed by the licensed registered agent.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 calendar days after each anniversary of incorporation, mandatory under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2019.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of WST 200 (approx. USD 75) plus daily default interest; continued default may trigger deregistration and disqualification of the registered agent if the agent fails to report.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Beneficial Ownership Registry, MCIL; coordinated and lodged by the licensed registered agent.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On the incorporation anniversary, aligned with the annual return; any change in beneficial ownership or shareholding must be updated in the BO register within 30 days of the change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Offence penalised by a fine of up to WST 10,000 (approx. USD 3,700) per default against the company and every defaulting officer; persistent non-compliance may be escalated to strike-off and disclosure to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for the unlicensed International Company. Samoa's International Companies Act 1987 (as amended) imposes no statutory audit or financial statement filing obligation on an IC. A mandatory audit arises only for a regulated license (e.g., banking, insurance, remittance, gaming) or by a shareholders' resolution; this affiliate media-buying entity is audit-exempt.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Not prescribed by SICA. IFRS is the accepted basis if voluntary financial statements are prepared; US GAAP or IFRS can be used for Mercury, Wise, or wire-transfer bank onboarding at the bank's discretion.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Beneficial Ownership Act 2017, the IC must deliver an initial BO return through its licensed Samoa registered agent, keep a current Register of Beneficial Owners at the registered office, and re-confirm the BO schedule annually with the annual return. Every share transfer during the year must be endorsed in the Register of Members and reflected in the BO register within 30 days; the annual confirmation is the mandated reconciliation point.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Directors' and Members' Meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600-1,200 per annum for a licensed Samoa registered agent including the registered office address and compliance coordination
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500-7,000 per engagement for a voluntary independent audit (not statutorily required)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (International Company tax-exempt status; the standard Samoa corporate rate for taxable resident companies is 27%)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Company is exempt from Samoan income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, stamp duty, gift duty, and estate duty under the International Companies Act 1987; only a fixed annual government renewal fee is paid based on authorised share capital.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: None (no Samoan corporate income tax return applicable to an International Company). Annual renewal application is made to the Office of the Registrar of International Companies (ORIC) through the licensed Samoa registered agent and the official Samoa electronic payment gateway.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual on the anniversary of incorporation
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Renewal and exemption affirmation must be completed before the anniversary date of incorporation; late renewal is possible only within the grace period prescribed by the Registrar, after which late penalties and deregistration procedures commence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 / Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the International Company exactly as it appears on the Certificate of Incorporation and the registration number assigned by the Registrar.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the official transliterated English legal name; no Samoan language translation is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The registered office address in Samoa maintained by the licensed international company service provider.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The address must be a physical office; a P.O. box cannot be the sole registered address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 / Directors, Shareholders and Beneficial Owners
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, nationality, and service-of-process details of all directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners as held in the register maintained by the agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Submit notarised passports, proof of residential address, and a source-of-funds declaration for each non-resident beneficial owner.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the International Company has not conducted business with Samoan residents or otherwise derived Samoan-source income during the relevant period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The declaration must be supported by the agent's annual review of the company's bank statements and advertising revenue contracts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of the prescribed annual renewal fee based on authorised share capital, and confirmation of payment through the licensed agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No operating income or asset declarations are filed; the fee is based solely on capital schedule.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal attracts a fixed late penalty from the Registrar plus a daily/default surcharge apportioned on the unpaid annual fee; continued non-payment for more than six months may lead to automatic cancellation of the International Company, striking-off from the register, and assets vesting in the Government of Samoa. No ordinary income-tax late-return penalty arises because no income-tax return is required.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%; an International Company distribution to non-resident shareholders is not subject to Samoa withholding tax because the IC is outside the scope of the Income Tax Act.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No DTA relief protocol is triggered by Samoan law because Samoa does not withhold on IC dividends. Where a source-state withholding tax is imposed on the shareholder, the Samoan IC must apply to the Samoa Ministry of Revenue for a Tax Residence Certificate (the TRC) using the prescribed Form, accompanied by the Certificate of Good Standing, an ESR substance declaration, register of shareholders, and audited profit statement; the TRC is granted only for the financial year and must be presented to the overseas payer before the distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory Samoan WHT for an International Company on outbound royalty and interest payments. For a taxable Samoan resident company, the standard statutory non-resident WHT rate is 15% on gross interest and royalties; a treaty reduction may be applied only where a valid TRC and supporting economic-substance file are submitted to the Samoan tax administration before remittance.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable for International Companies (no income tax liability); Samoa Revenue may nevertheless issue a specific documentary notice where connected-party transactions exceed WST 500,000 in a financial year and the exempt status is challenged. A taxable Samoan resident company preparing a Master File will require contemporaneous Local File documentation at moderate transaction levels and in all cases where the payer jurisdiction requires worldwide documentation.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa's Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) apply to International Companies carrying on relevant activities. The ESR require the company to maintain a physical office in Samoa, qualified employees and adequate expenditure, core income-generating activities and management meetings in Samoa, and full accounting records in Samoa. For an ISIC 7310 affiliate/media-buying company, the material relevant activity is a distribution and service centre if it renders services to related parties, or IP holding if it owns and licenses advertising technology. A pure passive holding exemption does not apply if campaign management, vendor contracting, media buying, and affiliate payout decisions are actually made outside Samoa.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Unfiled Samoan-Source Advertising Income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The International Company sells advertising or media-buying services to Samoan end clients, maintains a local office, employs media buyers in Apia, or receives Samoan-source commissions in a Samoan bank account, while still declaring itself wholly exempt and filing no tax return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Retroactive assessment at the 27% corporate income tax rate plus a fraud penalty of 100% of the shortfall and overdue interest; criminal liability for tax evasion exposes the company to a fine not exceeding WST 50,000 and imprisonment of officers for up to seven years; the Registrar will cancel IC status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil will be pierced because the IC is used as a facade for Samoan taxable business; directors and shadow directors are jointly and severally liable for evaded tax, penalties, and costs; court-imposed travel bans prevent departure from Samoa until civil restitution is made.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The affiliate media-buying IC has no Samoa office, no employees qualified to conduct media buying, no board meetings in Samoa, no Samoan bank account, and no accounting records, while claiming IC exemption and invoicing large volumes of foreign advertising spend.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Failure to satisfy an ESR substance notice results in an administrative penalty up to WST 100,000, disqualification from further business as an International Company, and mandatory cancellation from the International Companies Register; a separate fine of up to WST 10,000 is imposed for each false substance declaration filed with the Registrar.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers are personally liable for ESR penalties if they knowingly certified false declarations; resignations or share transfers made within 12 months before the ESR review are disregarded; directors receive a travel restriction order and may be disqualified for ten years from managing any Samoa International Company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering / Fraudulent Affiliate Traffic Monetisation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC processes affiliate commissions or media arbitrage payouts without conducting customer due diligence on advertisers and traffic vendors, fails to verify that the media inventory is genuine, and passes funds through multiple Samoan or foreign accounts connected to click injection and bot traffic.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Breach of the Samoa Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act 2007 carries a corporate fine not exceeding WST 500,000, confiscation of all proceeds linked to the fraudulent advertising scheme, and freezing orders on the IC bank accounts; failure to file a suspicious transaction report with the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit triggers an additional daily fine until compliance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors implicated in the scheme face personal criminal prosecution with imprisonment up to ten years, asset confiscation orders, and travel bans; banks will freeze the directors' personal bank accounts, and the court may order civil restitution to defrauded advertisers before any corporate liquidation is accepted.
